column8: Bit 0 = Communications; Bit 1 = Local Off; Bit 2 = Remote Off; Bit 3 = High Head Pressure 1; Bit 4 = High Head Pressure 2; Bit 5 = Loss of Airflow; Bit 6 = Standby Glycol Unit On; Bit 8 = Change Filters; Bit 9 = High Temperature; Bit 10 = Low Temperature
Bit 0 = High Humidity; Bit 1 = Low Humidity; Bit 2 = Humidifier Problem; Bit 8 = Smoke Detected; Bit 9 = Loss of Water Flow; Bit 10 = Standby Unit On
Bit 1 = Short Cycle; Bit 2 = Loss of Power; Bit 6 = Local Alarm 1; Bit 7 = Local Alarm 2; Bit 8 = High Water; Bit 9 = Local Alarm 3

Unit On/Off: Bit 0 - ON = Unit Off Bit 1 - ON = Unit On; Reheat Lockout: Bit 2 - ON = Reheat Lockout Off Bit 3 - ON = Reheat Lockout On*; Humidifier Lockout: Bit 4 - ON = Humidifier Lockout Off Bit 5 - ON = Humidifier Lockout On*
